day_local: Xuska Soo Bandhigidda Maryan oo bikrad ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Ilaah ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Sayidow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Sayidow, naxariiso.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan garoonka diyaaradaha, adigoo daawanaya diyaaradaha oo si xarrago leh u kala dillaacaya daruuraha. Waxaa jira wax gaar ah oo ku saabsan in la arko wax weyn oo hawada u kacaya, waxaana la socda xamaasadda qofka jecel aviation-ka. Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu lahaa xamaasad noocaas ah. Wuxuu jeclaa diyaaradaha, wuxuuna ku riyoon jiray 'con chim airlines'. Laakiin ka sokow tiknoolajiyadda iyo xisaabta uu ku fiicnaa, waxaa jiray wax ka sii weyn: wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. Maanta, xuska Soo Bandhigidda Maryan, waxaan xasuusanaynaa sida Maryan loo geeyey macbudka si ay nafteeda ugu hurto Ilaah. Ben-na, noloshiisa gaaban, wuxuu ahaa mid si qoto dheer ugu xiran Ilaah.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, Yooxanaa wuxuu arkay laba geed oo saytuun ah iyo laba shumacaad oo hor taagan Rabbiga dunida. Kuwani waa markhaatiyaal. Waxay ku nool yihiin adduun ay ka buuxaan dhibaatooyin, laakiin waxay ku sii jiraan joogitaanka Ilaah. Waxay la mid yihiin Ben oo noo ahaa markhaati jacayl iyo daacadnimo ah. Waxaa la yiri: 'Markay markhaatifurkooda dhammaysteen, bahalkii ka soo baxay yaamayska ayaa la dagaallamay.' Tani waa xaqiiqada nolosha—mararka qaarkood xanuunka iyo dhimashadu waxay u muuqdaan inay guulaysteen. Laakiin xusuuso waxa dhacay: 'Neef nolosha Ilaah ka timid ayaa gashay iyagii.'

Injiilka maanta, Sadduqiyiintu waxay Ciise weydiinayaan su'aal ku saabsan sarakicidda, iyagoo isku dayaya inay runta ka dhigaan wax aan macquul ahayn. Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay si ka duwan sida ay filayeen. Wuxuu yiri: 'Ilaah ma aha Ilaaha kuwa dhintay, ee waa Ilaaha kuwa nool, waayo isaga xaggiisa dhammaantood way nool yihiin.' Kani waa furaha xanuunkeenna. Ben ma dhiman; wuxuu ku nool yahay joogitaanka Ilaah. Isaga xaggiisa, Ben waa mid nool.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil doonayay inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Xusuusta uu aabbihiis ka sheegay ee ku saabsan sida uu u rabay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William, waa tusaale saafi ah oo ah wiil qalbigiisu uu furnaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana ku rabaa naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan ruux ahaan u gal qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda kuu dhiibayaa adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad. Aamiin.
petition_call: Waxaan Rabbiga u baryaynaa inuu na maqlo.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay oo dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku dejiyo iftiinkiisa iyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa cidhiidhiga ku jira, inuu Ilaah siiyo rajo, xoog, iyo naxariis uu qalbigooda ku dejiyo.

readings.label: Akhriska koowaad
readings.text: Waxaan maqlay cod samada ka imanaya oo igu leh: Kuwani waa labadayda markhaati; waa labada geed oo saytuun ah iyo labada shumacaad oo hor taagan Rabbiga dunida. Haddii qof doonayo inuu waxyeelleeyo, dab baa afkooda ka soo baxaya oo baabbi'inaya cadowgooda. Sidaas daraaddeed, qof kasta oo doonaya inuu waxyeelleeyo waa in la dilaa. Waxay awood u leeyihiin inay xiraan samada si aan roob u da'in inta ay wax sii sheegayaan. Waxay kaloo awood u leeyihiin inay biyaha u beddelaan dhiig, oo ay dhulka ku ridaan belaayooyin mar kasta oo ay doonaan. Markay dhammaystaan markhaatifurkooda, bahalka ka soo baxa yaamayska ayaa la dagaallami doona, wuuna ka adkaan doonaa, wuuna dili doonaa. Meydadkoodu waxay yaalliin jidka weyn ee magaalada weyn, oo loo bixiyey magacyada calaamadeed ee 'Sodom' iyo 'Masar', meeshii Rabbigooda lagu qodbay. Dadka ka mid ah qabiil kasta, qowmiyad kasta, luuqad kasta, iyo qaran kasta ayaa eegi doona meydadkooda saddex maalmood iyo badh, mana oggolaan doonaan in meydadkooda la aaso. Dadka dhulka deggan ayaa ku farxi doona, wayna isku hambalyayn doonaan, iyagoo hadiyado isdhaafsanaya, sababtoo ah labadan nebi ayaa dhibay dadka dhulka deggan. Laakiin saddex maalmood iyo badh ka dib, neef nolosha Ilaah ka timid ayaa gashay iyagii. Markay cagahooda ku istaageen, cabsi weyn baa ku dhacday kuwii arkay. Markaasay maqleen cod weyn oo samada ka imanaya oo ku leh: 'Halkan kor u kaca.' Markaasay samada u kaceen iyadoo daruur ku jirta, iyadoo cadowgoodu eegayo.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Barakaysan yahay Rabbiga, dhagaxayga! Barakaysan yahay Rabbiga, dhagaxayga, oo gacmahayga u tababara dagaal, farahaygana u diyaariya dagaal. R. Barakaysan yahay Rabbiga, dhagaxayga! Naxariistayda iyo qalcaddayda, meeladayda adag iyo badbaadiyahayga, gaashankayga, kan aan isku halleeyo, oo dadkayga ii hoos geliya. R. Barakaysan yahay Rabbiga, dhagaxayga! Ilaahow, waxaan kuu qaadi doonaa hees cusub; waxaan ku ammaani doonaa kaban toban xadhig leh, adiga oo guul siiya boqorrada, oo addoonkaaga Daa'uud ka badbaadiya seefta sharka leh. R. Barakaysan yahay Rabbiga, dhagaxayga!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Qaar ka mid ah Sadduqiyiinta, kuwa diida inay jirto sarakicid, ayaa u yimid Ciise, waxayna weydiiyeen su'aal iyagoo leh: Macallimow, Muuse wuxuu noo qoray, haddii qof walaalkiis dhinto isagoo aan carruur lahayn, walaalkiis waa inuu guursadaa naagta si uu u dhaliyo farac walaalkiis. Waxaa jiray toddoba walaalo ah; kii ugu horreeyey wuxuu guursaday naag, wuuna dhintay isagoo aan carruur lahayn. Markaasay kii labaad iyo kii saddexaad guursadeen, sidaas oo kalena toddobadii oo dhan way dhinteen iyagoo aan carruur lahayn. Ugu dambayntii naagtiina way dhimatay. Haddaba sarakicidda, naagtaasi kee bay naag u ahaan doontaa? Waayo toddobadii oo dhan baa guursaday. Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi: Dadka wakhtigan way guursadaan, wayna is-guursadaan; laakiin kuwa loo arko inay u qalmaan inay gaaraan wakhtiga soo socda iyo sarakicidda dadka dhintay, midna ma guursado, midna lama guursado. Mar dambe ma dhiman karaan, waayo waxay la mid yihiin malaa'igaha; waana carruurta Ilaah, waayo iyagu waa kuwa sarakici doona. In dadka dhintay ay sarakici doonaan, Muuse wuu caddeeyey qaybta ku saabsan duurka, markuu 'Rabbiga' ugu yeeray Ilaaha Ibraahim, Ilaaha Isxaaq, iyo Ilaaha Yacquub; isaguna ma aha Ilaaha kuwa dhintay, ee waa Ilaaha kuwa nool, waayo isaga xaggiisa dhammaantood way nool yihiin. Qaar ka mid ah culimmadii sharciga ayaa u jawaabay oo yidhi: Macallimow, si fiican baad u jawaabtay. Mar dambena kuma ay dhiiran inay waxba weydiiyaan.

day: Memorial of the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
